name: brightlife
vibe: Bright Life — a luminous, bright-cinematic launch-film system in the register above Apple / Stripe / Linear / Framer / OpenAI marketing videos, but never dark. An airy white canvas washed with soft pastel mesh gradients; floating gradient orbs with Gaussian blur, translucent glass shapes, torus and rings drifting in real depth; white glassmorphic product cards presenting live dashboards; a cinematic parallax camera; and big, confident Space Grotesk display type with an indigo-to-violet gradient highlight. Optimistic, premium, future-ready.
